notes: Read all 143 source lines before editing. The hook is pure Date arithmetic + i18n with no DOM/browser/Recharts/Leaflet/web-UI dependency, so logic, state names, i18n keys, and comments are ported 1:1; the only substantive change is the translation source.

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` -> react-i18next is absent from apps/native deps, so it is replaced by a local key-preserving fallback shim (TFunc type + module-stable fallbackT + local `function useTranslation(): { t: TFunc }`), matching the established native parity pattern (components/motion/index.ts, components/ui/Label.tsx).
